question: In a certain code language, WELCOME is coded as ZHOFRPH. Which of the given options would be coded as DUSSRDFK in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c193461e71dcd46b8837f5f79d7b09c44e036a8adcc80d5d88d8d02cd78c37f.png] 

The code for WELCOME is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7ad4c6020ce19d3b149a757108953924f7c79b078dc5ac71ba8b8298dd9de48.png] 

Similarly, DUSSRDFK is the code of :

 
• **? = DUSSRDFK **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/235f9896af4184a38595c415e55b99888eaa320937b84d4aca01a7f6b8061ffc.png]
